notes.title: Soundtrack Launch
notes.notes:
Featuring six tracks straight from the game, including five moving arrangements of 90’s classics which Ola and Mary play at home.

As our games are free, purchasing this soundtrack is a great way to show support!

You can get the soundtrack here:

notes.title: Play the Prequel: The Night Fisherman
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340810/The_Night_Fisherman/

Before the story of the Outcast Lovers came the story of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340810/The_Night_Fisherman/]The Night Fisherman[/url]

The Night fisherman is the first chapter in an anthology series we're calling The Sacrifices.

[i]You are a night fisherman. You are smuggling goods into England. You spot a boat approaching. The man on the boat has a shotgun slung across his back. What do you do? [/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340810/The_Night_Fisherman/]Play it for free now![/url]
